description: S462 fix round 2 (N1) — a destructured local named like a file function is a VALUE, not that function: calling it is a call whose write set cannot be determined, so the narrowing ends; the bare `@user.name` after it is E-TYPE-046.
rationale: §42.3.5 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "b"): "…or by a call that writes it or whose write set cannot be determined — ends the narrowing from that point"
